title: Create operation request
description: Creates a durable operation for a robot. v1 supports exactly one authenticated diagnostic kind; the platform dispatches it over the device WebSocket as soon as the robot is connected. The Idempotency-Key header (optional) scopes retries: same key and identical body replay the original operation, same key with a different body is a 409 conflict. The stored record expires after 24 hours; one-time credential responses are never replayed from idempotency records.
